card.name: Start of iodine-based drug names
card.fires_on: The first piece of iodine-related words such as iodinated, iodixanol, iodide and iodine, mostly in contrast-agent and thyroid-blockade labels. It also fires weakly on a few other word starts like referral and prescribers.

modes.description: The opening piece of iodinated, iodixanol, iodide or iodine, before the rest of the word.
